title: VaultGraph: stop the RAF loop and per-frame getComputedStyle
text:
Fixed the two CPU-burn issues in `VaultGraph.tsx`'s canvas animation:

1. **RAF loop now stops when settled.** `loop()` checks `alpha <= 0.06 && !drag.current` after each `step()+draw()`; if true it sets `raf = 0` and returns instead of rescheduling. title: Fixed two performance issues: keystroke re-renders and a never-stopping canvas loop
text:
Audited the renderer for perf issues and found two real ones, delegated a fix for each, verified both (typecheck clean, 24/24 tests pass).

**1. Every keystroke in the code editor re-rendered the entire app window.** `Editor.tsx`'s CodeMirror `onChange` pushed each keystroke straight into `App.tsx`'s `files` state, and nothing in the tree was memoized — so typing re-rendered the sidebar, tabs, terminals, and status bar on every character. Fixed by buffering edits locally and committing to app state ~200ms after typing pauses, flushing immediately on tab close/app quit so no keystrokes are lost

title: Debounce editor keystrokes out of App state (fix full-app re-render on typing)
text:
Root cause: `Editor.tsx`'s CodeMirror `onChange` called `setFiles` (App-level state) on every keystroke, re-rendering the whole tree (sidebar, tabs, terminals, VaultGraph — none memoized).

Fix, following the `editorStore.ts` out-of-React-store pattern already in this repo and the debounce idiom already used in `lspExtensions.ts`'s LSP change sync:

- `Editor.tsx`: `onChange` now buffers the latest value in a ref (`pendingEdit`) and only calls `setFiles` ~200ms after typing pauses (`flushEdit`). Flushed early on: tab switch/unmount (existing `[activePath]` cleanup effect), `beforeunload`, and
